title: Rectangular base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. The sketch consists of two loops. For the first loop, draw four lines: start from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0214, 0.0), then from (0.0214, 0.0) to (0.0214, 0.0214), next from (0.0214, 0.0214) to (0.0, 0.0214), and finally from (0.0, 0.0214) back to the origin. For the second loop, draw four lines: start from (0.0008, 0.0008) to (0.0206, 0.0008), then from (0.0206, 0.0008) to (0.0206, 0.0206), next from (0.0206, 0.0206) to (0.0008, 0.0206), and finally from (0.0008, 0.0206) back to (0.0008, 0.0008). Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0214. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space with no rotation and no translation. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units in the positive normal direction and 0.0 units in the negative normal direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular base are 0.02142857142857143 meters in length, 0.02142857142857143 meters in width, and 0.75 meters in height.

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the outer rectangle
r = r.box(0.0214, 0.0214, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False))

# Create the inner rectangle

# Cut the inner rectangle from the outer rectangle
r = r.cut(inner_rectangle)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
outer_size = 0.0214
height = 0.75
wall = 0.003

# Outer square profile
outer = cq.Workplane("XY").rect(outer_size, outer_size).extrude(height)

# Inner hollow square profile (tube)
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=0.0)
    .rect(outer_size - 2 * wall, outer_size - 2 * wall)
    .extrude(height)
)

# Hollow square tube
r = outer.cut(inner)
